data.body: Operator 2026-09-28 asked whether ddflow logs bugs, lessons, session logs and compaction-time summaries; exposes them to the agent (MCP/RAG, encouraged) and to the user (commands + prompts: list bugs/lessons/decisions, latest, most repeated, search sessions/log, summaries, most relevant); and supports correction, compaction, reordering and dedupe. Audit (main 5a130d3): capture, BM25 recall (store.py:311) and agent nudges (brief, SessionStart hook, MCP instructions, obligations footer) exist. Gaps filed here. Nothing is ever erased from the log: curation = new events (edited/retired/merged), folded.
data.title: Knowledge for the agent AND the operator: capture at compaction, list/summarize/recurrence views, curation (edit, retire, dedupe, merge, priority)

data.body: Audit: store.py:469 _insert_sessions indexes prompts and notes only; the session.ended summary is folded but never indexed, so recall for the B185 summary text returns nothing. (a) index summaries as role 'summary' (id <session>#s); (b) recall labels them SESSION SUMMARY; (c) 'ddflow session list [--latest N]' (id, opened/closed, item(s), summary first line) and 'ddflow session show <id>' (prompts, notes, summary in order); MCP ddflow_session_list / ddflow_session_show. Regression test: recall finds a summary-only phrase; fails on current code.
data.title: Session summaries are searchable: index session.ended summaries in recall; session list/show (CLI + MCP)

data.body: Audit: only a SessionStart hook exists (claudehooks.py:34, matcher includes 'compact'); it re-injects the brief AFTER compaction, but nothing records what the session did. (a) 'ddflow hooks install' also adds a PreCompact hook -> 'ddflow hooks pre-compact' reads the hook JSON (session_id, transcript_path, trigger manual/auto) and records a session note of role 'compaction' carrying the compaction summary if available, else a bounded digest of the transcript tail (budgeted by a knob, secrets redacted like session prompt); (b) SessionStart:compact output asks the agent to write 'ddflow session note --role summary' if none landed; (c) hooks status/uninstall cover it; other hooks left untouched as today. Research first: verify the current PreCompact payload via context7/Claude Code docs. Always exit 0 — a hook must never block compaction.
data.title: Capture a session summary at context compaction: Claude Code PreCompact hook + SessionStart:compact fallback

data.body: Audit: no 'bug list' (only 'history --kind bug'); lessons only via 'render --show lessons' grouped by tag, not date; MCP resources cover board/brief/lessons/research only (mcp.py:2500). Add: 'ddflow bug list [--open|--fixed|--all] [--item] [--since] [--limit]' newest first with regression test + lesson columns; 'ddflow lesson list [--latest N] [--tag] [--all incl. superseded]'; decision list gets --since/--limit; --json on all. MCP ddflow_bug_list, ddflow_lesson_list; resources ddflow://bugs, ddflow://decisions, ddflow://sessions (after B194). Exit 2 on empty, like memory list.
data.title: Operator list views: bug list, lesson list (latest/tag), decision parity; MCP tools + ddflow://bugs, decisions, sessions resources

data.body: Audit: lesson seen_in is merged on re-record (model.py:990) but never counted; nothing ranks repeats. (a) 'ddflow bug found --recurs-of <bug|lesson>' records the link (event data, folded); (b) 'ddflow lesson list --by recurrence' / 'ddflow bug list --by recurrence' count seen_in + linked bugs + recurs-of chains; (c) 'ddflow knowledge top [--limit]' one view of the most-repeated lessons and bug families; MCP ddflow_knowledge_top. A lesson whose pattern reappeared in 'lesson verify' counts as a recurrence too.
data.title: Recurrence: which lessons and bugs we repeat most (seen_in counts, bug->lesson links, 'recurs-of' on bug found)

data.body: Audit: nothing detects duplicate knowledge; dedupe_sweep / code-deduplication are about CODE (config.py:690). (a) lesson add / bug found run a similarity probe over the FTS index and WARN (not refuse) naming the near-duplicates, --json carries them; (b) 'ddflow knowledge dupes [--kind lesson|bug] [--threshold]' lists candidate pairs with scores; (c) 'ddflow lesson merge <dup> --into <keep>' (union seen_in/tags, dup superseded_by keep) and 'ddflow bug close <id> --as duplicate --of <id>'; bugs gain a resolution state (fixed|duplicate|wontfix|invalid) — duplicate/wontfix close WITHOUT a regression test but only with a reason; (d) MCP tools for each; recall/brief hide merged duplicates. Wire the dedupe_sweep cadence to also mention 'knowledge dupes'.
data.title: Duplicate lessons and bugs: detect (BM25 similarity) at add time and on demand; merge with a recorded event

data.body: Audit: correction today = re-record with the same id; the merge fold (model.py:960) keeps old values for empty fields, so a field can never be cleared, and there is no retire without --supersedes. (a) '<kind>.edited' events carrying an explicit field set (empty string = clear), with --reason; (b) 'ddflow lesson edit|bug edit|decision edit <id> --field value ...'; (c) 'ddflow lesson retire <id> --reason' (retired lessons leave brief/recall/LESSONS.md, stay in replay history); (d) MCP equivalents; (e) edits survive shard reordering (fold test with shuffled merge, like the superseded_by regression).
data.title: Correct and retire knowledge: lesson/bug/decision edit (can clear fields), lesson retire without a replacement

data.body: Audit: 'ddflow history' filters by --item/--kind/--since only; recall covers indexed tables but not gate outcomes, block reasons, lease events, etc. Add --grep <regex|text> (case-insensitive, over the event's rendered line + data values) and --agent; same params on ddflow_history. Lamport order kept.
data.title: Free-text search over the whole event log: history --grep, and ddflow_history query

data.body: Audit: shipped prompts (services/prompts.py:72) are all work-flow ones; nothing lets the operator ask 'list the bugs / the latest lessons / what we repeat / summarize the log'. Add prompts driving the B194-B200 tools, each with an optional scope arg: lessons (latest, top, by tag, most relevant to <scope>), bugs (open/fixed/recurring), decisions (in force + applicable to a path), summarize-log (sessions + progress + lessons since <scope>, human prose), curate-knowledge (dupes -> propose merges/edits/retires/pins to the OPERATOR, apply only what they approve, record each). Also adopt installs them as Claude Code slash commands like /implement.
data.title: Shipped MCP prompts for the operator: /lessons, /bugs, /decisions, /summarize-log, /curate-knowledge

data.body: Audit: work items have priority; lessons/bugs/decisions do not, and the only digest is lessons-summary (one paragraph per lesson, by tag). (a) 'ddflow lesson pin|unpin <id>' and a priority field (event, folded); pinned lessons always appear in the brief within budget, ahead of BM25 hits; (b) 'ddflow render --show digest': a compacted view — live lessons clustered (by tag + merged dupes), open bugs, decisions in force — budgeted by a knob; (c) staleness hint: lessons never matched by recall/brief in N phases are listed as retire candidates for curate-knowledge.
data.title: Knowledge priority and a compacted digest: pin/rank lessons, brief honours pins, render --show digest

data.body: Audit: recall is FTS5 BM25 with porter stemming, LIKE fallback (store.py:17,311); no embeddings, so paraphrases miss ('lesson search worktree' found nothing). Research gate first: local model options (e.g. sentence-transformers / fastembed / sqlite-vec) vs the zero-dependency promise; measure recall@k on this repo's own log vs BM25. If adopted: [lessons] search_backend = 'hybrid' opt-in, extra deps optional, missing backend -> BM25 with the fallback reported (never silently), index rebuilt from the log like FTS.
data.title: Optional semantic recall: an embeddings backend beside BM25 (research first, opt-in, degrade to BM25 and say so)

data.body: Audit: recall is encouraged (MCP instructions, CLAUDE.md, brief) but nothing checks it happened. (a) recall records a lightweight 'recall.ran' event with query + item (when an item is claimed by the caller); (b) obligations.py names 'B<id> claimed, implement started, no recall run' in the footer, cheap-remedy first like the others; (c) optional: the research gate's evidence shows the recall queries. Must not become a banner (see B158/B159).
